title: Backend Engineer Intern
description: Ledgerly builds payment reconciliation software for Indian SMEs. As a backend intern you will work on our Java 21 and Spring Boot services that match bank statements against invoices. You will write REST APIs, design PostgreSQL tables, use Redis for caching and idempotency keys, and write tests with JUnit and Testcontainers. Good fit for students who know Java, SQL and data structures. Stipend 50k per month, 6 months.

title: Backend Intern - Python
description: Hirewise matches candidates to jobs using embeddings and large language models. You will build FastAPI services in Python, store vectors in PostgreSQL with pgvector, write prompts and evaluate ranking quality. We want someone who has built at least one backend project end to end and is curious about LLM applications. Students welcome. Paid internship with PPO.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Rupeeflow is a payments gateway processing millions of UPI transactions per day. We are hiring a senior backend engineer with 6+ years of experience in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and distributed systems. You will own the settlement service, lead design reviews and mentor junior engineers. Experience running high throughput systems in production is required.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Textloom builds document understanding models for insurance companies. As an ML intern you will train and fine-tune models in Python and PyTorch, clean labelled datasets, and measure precision and recall on extraction tasks. Knowledge of NLP basics, numpy and pandas is expected. Final year and pre-final year students can apply.

title: AI Engineer Intern
description: Askwell is building an AI support agent for D2C brands. You will build retrieval augmented generation pipelines: chunking help docs, generating embeddings, vector search, prompt design and evaluation of answers. Python, FastAPI and some SQL required. Bonus if you have shipped a side project using an LLM API. Stipend 60k to 80k per month.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Cartwise is a grocery delivery startup. The data analyst intern will write SQL queries on our order data, build dashboards in Tableau, and use Excel and Python pandas for ad hoc analysis on delivery times and customer retention. Strong SQL and clear communication matter more than fancy models.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Pixelnest builds design collaboration tools. As a frontend intern you will build React and TypeScript components, work with our designers in Figma, write unit tests and improve page performance. You should be comfortable with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React hooks. 6 month internship, hybrid.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: We are looking for a senior frontend engineer with 5+ years of React experience to lead our editor team. You will make architecture decisions for a large TypeScript codebase, own rendering performance for canvas heavy pages and mentor interns. Prior experience leading a team is required.

title: Android Developer Intern
description: Ridelane is a bike taxi app. Android intern will build features in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, integrate REST APIs, handle offline caching and work on app performance on low end devices. Students who have published an app on the Play Store are preferred.

title: iOS Engineer
description: iOS engineer with 3+ years of Swift and SwiftUI experience to own the rider app. You will work on maps, payments and real time location updates, and set up CI for releases. Experience with App Store release processes is required.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Cloudmint runs managed databases for startups. We need a DevOps engineer with 4+ years of experience in Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform and Prometheus. You will manage multi region clusters, automate deployments and be part of the on call rotation.

title: Site Reliability Intern
description: SRE intern to help us improve monitoring and incident response. You will work with Linux, Docker, Grafana dashboards and write small automation scripts in Python or Bash. Good understanding of operating systems and networking basics is expected. Students welcome.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description: Shopkart is an e-commerce platform for small sellers. The full stack intern will build features across our Node.js and Express backend and React frontend, with MongoDB as the database. You will own small features from API to UI. Stipend 30k per month.

title: Data Engineer
description: Data engineer with 3+ years of experience building batch and streaming pipelines with Apache Spark, Airflow and Python. You will own our warehouse in BigQuery, data quality checks and pipelines feeding the analytics team.

title: QA Automation Intern
description: Testbay provides testing services to banks. The QA automation intern will write automated UI and API tests using Selenium, Java and TestNG, maintain test suites in CI and report bugs clearly. Basic Java and an eye for detail are required.

title: Business Development Associate - Unpaid Internship
description: Growthly is a marketing agency. This is an unpaid internship for business development. You will do cold calling, generate leads on LinkedIn, follow up with clients and help close sales deals. Certificate provided on completion. No coding involved.

title: Sales Intern
description: Sales intern for our SaaS reseller team. Unpaid for the first two months, then performance based incentives. Daily targets for calls and demos with small business owners. Strong spoken English and Hindi required.

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Design intern to create wireframes, user flows and high fidelity mockups in Figma. You will run small usability tests and work closely with frontend developers. Share a portfolio with at least two case studies.

title: Software Engineer Intern - Distributed Systems
description: Pulsewire builds an event streaming platform. Interns work on our Go and Java services built on Kafka and PostgreSQL: consumer groups, exactly once processing, retries and backpressure. We look for strong fundamentals in data structures, concurrency and databases. Previous backend project experience is a plus.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Healthnest runs online doctor consultations. Backend engineer with 2+ years of Python and Django experience, PostgreSQL and Celery. You will build appointment scheduling, payments integration and APIs for our mobile apps.

title: SDE Intern
description: Algoforge builds coding assessment tools. We hire SDE interns with strong problem solving skills: data structures, algorithms and competitive programming in C++ or Java. You will build the code execution sandbox, test case judges and plagiarism checks. Codeforces or LeetCode ratings welcome in your application.

title: Content Writer Intern
description: Write blog posts, newsletters and social media copy for our clients in edtech and fintech. Strong written English, basic SEO knowledge and the ability to meet weekly deadlines. Part time, stipend 10k per month.

title: NLP Research Intern
description: Research intern to experiment with transformer models for long document question answering. You will read papers, reproduce baselines in PyTorch and Hugging Face, and write up results. Strong Python, linear algebra and some deep learning coursework required.

title: Search Engineer Intern
description: Findr is a product search API for online stores. The intern will work on ranking: BM25, embeddings based semantic search, hybrid retrieval and offline evaluation with metrics like precision at k and NDCG. Python and SQL required. Interest in information retrieval is a big plus.

title: Risk Analytics Intern
description: Help our credit team build risk scores for SME borrowers. You will write SQL and Python to analyse repayment data, create features and monitor default rates. Interest in fintech and lending, good statistics basics and strong SQL are expected.

title: Embedded Systems Intern
description: Voltix makes battery management systems for electric scooters. Intern will write firmware in C for ARM microcontrollers, work with CAN bus and test hardware in our lab. Electronics or ECE background preferred.

title: Product Manager Intern
description: Product intern to talk to sellers, write product requirement documents, define success metrics and work with engineering and design to ship features. Analytical mindset and clear writing required. Engineering background is a plus but not needed.

title: Blockchain Developer Intern
description: Build smart contracts in Solidity, write tests with Hardhat and integrate wallets into our web app. Knowledge of Ethereum, ERC-20 tokens and basic cryptography is needed.

title: Backend Developer Intern - Microservices
description: Logisync builds shipment tracking for logistics companies. Interns work on Spring Boot microservices, PostgreSQL, Redis and Docker, with resilience patterns like retries and circuit breakers for courier partner APIs. Good Java and SQL fundamentals required. Stipend 40k per month with PPO opportunity.

title: Customer Support Executive
description: Handle seller queries over chat, email and phone, resolve order issues and escalate bugs to the tech team. Rotational shifts. Good communication in English and Hindi required.
